reconcile.note: Gill reads the all-things already delivered as core gospel doctrine, with the many things still withheld reserved for events after the resurrection.

discrepancy.emptyNote: Raymond E. Brown catalogues this as a contradiction, but the project's public-domain source survey found no verbatim critic passage that engages it.
discrepancy.emptyNoteAttr: Raymond E. Brown, The Gospel According to John (XIII-XXI), Anchor Bible 29A (1970).

sides.snippet: everything that I heard from my Father, I have made known to you.
sides.verseText: No longer do I call you servants, for the servant doesn't know what his lord does. But I have called you friends, for everything that I heard from my Father, I have made known to you.

sides.snippet: I have yet many things to tell you, but you can't bear them now.
sides.verseText: \"I have yet many things to tell you, but you can't bear them now.
